body:
Addressed:

- Added before and after screenshots for the Properties tool page and Tool shape window to the PR body. All four images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `9e0e6ec5f9b1561c4ed14313c72cf18cf11c6911`. No images are on the PR branch.
- Guarded the existing-tool heading and actions against an empty Properties target. `new_tool_matching_saved_name_has_no_empty_target_actions` pins the matching-name path, Apply, and Close. Reverting only the guard made the test fail. Restoring the guard made it pass. The final test also passed.

New head: `4f75a6692f7bf7d7fb17bcf73b8c672bad206a83`.

The quick gate passed all 9 selected steps after one failed-step rerun. The first UI library run exited with SIGSEGV. The rerun passed 1284 tests, with 0 failures and 7 ignored. Clippy passed for `camcraft-ui`, with 0 warnings.

Please re-review this head.

Addressed:

- The PR body links before and after images for Properties and Tool shape. All four files exist on the fork's images-only branch at `9e0e6ec5f9b1561c4ed14313c72cf18cf11c6911`.
- The existing-tool heading and actions require a nonempty target. `new_tool_matching_saved_name_has_no_empty_target_actions` checks the matching-name draft, hidden actions, Apply, and Close.

Current head: `4f75a6692f7bf7d7fb17bcf73b8c672bad206a83`.

Both requested changes are already present on this head. The latest review applies to the previous head, `1fd8359e893fb3c14217090fc0838676f37cdf77`. This run made no code changes.

The previous fix report records the mutation check: removing the guard failed the test; restoring it passed. It also records all 9 quick-gate steps passing after a failed-step rerun, and UI clippy passing. This run did not repeat those checks.

Please re-review the current head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4f75a6692f7bf7d7fb17bcf73b8c672bad206a83 -->
Verdict: clean. No blockers at this head.

This review is a read of the current head `4f75a6692`. It is not built (the coordinator holds the build slot). The earlier review's two requests are both met by the new head:

1. Screenshots. The PR body now links four before/after images from the fork's images-only branch: Properties page, and the `Tool shape` window. No image is committed to the PR branch.
2. The empty tool name in `tool_settings::page`. Commit `4f75a6692` changes `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:53` to `if exists && !name.is_empty()`. The existing-tool actions now stay hidden while the Properties target is empty. The commit adds the pinning test `new_tool_matching_saved_name_has_no_empty_target_actions` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_shape_window.rs`. The test is structural: AccessKit labels and state, no positions. Its commit message ends `Fixes #2007`.

The new commit is PR code, not a merge of main (class: NEW CODE). Its diff is two files: the one-line guard and the 46-line test. No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` outside tests. The change touches no posted G-code, collision or gouge check, simulation, or geometry.

Per the law, a gate on the merged tree is still required before the merge (this head has not been built by any review in this session).
